title.es: Ontología de actividad WiFi CSI de EHUNAM

description.en: Ontology for describing WiFi CSI measurements of human and machine activity captured in different environments.
description.es: Ontología para describir mediciones WiFi CSI de actividad humana y de máquinas capturadas en diferentes entornos.

abstract.value: This ontology provides a structured representation of WiFi Channel State Information (CSI) measurements, including details about the measurement environment, involved persons, activities performed, and technical parameters.

title.value: Ontología de actividad WiFi CSI de EHUNAM
